wins: Go wide with cheap Starfleet officers, reach 8 total power, and swing every turn while "power 8" triggers pile up.
plan: Play cheap crew: Tactical Officer, Beckett Mariner, Worf, Troi, Picard (Leading by Example) and Munitions Enthusiast. Play Deanna Troi before the others so later creatures enter with a +1/+1 counter.
Captain Jean-Luc Picard: +1/+1 to your team and a free 1/1 Officer for every creature you cast. Captain Kirk makes an Officer, pumps the team or filters a card each time he enters or attacks.

Add up your creatures’ power before combat. At 8 or more, attacking triggers Tactical Officer, Worf, Una Chin-Riley and Kirk, Commanding Officer all at once. The Enterprise-A brings three Officers immediately.
keys: Your best card: an anthem plus a token every time you cast a creature. Protect him or recast him.
Card advantage on attack once you have 8 power, and he can sacrifice himself to destroy an artifact or enchantment.
Three Officers on arrival. Station it (tap creatures for charge counters) only on turns you are not attacking with them.
One mana: stun a blocker before your attack, or deal 3 to a creature attacking you.
tips: Most of your creatures are legendary: hold the second copy as backup instead of playing it.
Don’t hold creatures back to block. The deck wins by making the opponent react.
Sacred Foundry: pay 2 life for an untapped land only if you need the mana that turn.
Munitions Enthusiast pings 1 damage when it dies, so trade it in combat freely.
mulligan: Keep 2–4 lands with at least two creatures that cost 1–3. Mulligan hands with no plays before turn 3.
